sources.label: Google Reviews (Google Travel/Hotels panel)
sources.notes: Richest, most searchable corpus. Use in-panel "Search reviews" + topic chips. Filtered views cap ~10 per query — run every keyword across all three sort strategies (most_helpful, lowest_score, most_recent) and dedupe by author+date.
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ reviews

sources.label: TripAdvisor
sources.notes: Server-side fetch is 403-blocked — logged-in browser only. Use review search + "Popular mentions" chips. The ABSENCE of entertainment from popular mentions is itself a finding worth capturing.
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ reviews

sources.label: Booking.com
sources.notes: "Read all reviews" modal has a topic search. Structured liked/disliked fields give clean attribution. Category sub-scores (Value, Staff, etc.) are tell-tale signals. Often blocks server fetch.
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ reviews

sources.label: Expedia
sources.notes: Tends to skew more recent. Note: shares the Expedia-Group review DB with Travelocity — never count both as independent platforms in client-facing scorecards.
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ reviews

sources.label: Travelocity
sources.notes: NOT an independent source — shares the Expedia-Group review DB. Capture only for reference; never double-count toward "platforms cross-checked".
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ reviews

sources.label: Reddit
sources.notes: Direct fetch is usually blocked. Harvest verbatim quotes from Google "site:reddit.com" result snippets (#:~:text= fragments). Candid signal — often surfaces things review platforms hide.
plannedQueries: site:reddit.com The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ

sources.label: YouTube (walkthroughs / vlogs)
sources.notes: Walkthrough chapter titles reveal the named-venue inventory (this is how venue lists are recovered without floor plans). Titles + comments are also guest-generated signal.
plannedQueries: The Phoenician Tavern Scottsdale, AZ tour

sources.label: Travel blogs / longform guest posts
sources.notes: Useful for noise/atmosphere callouts and longer-form anecdotes that capped review fields cannot hold.

sources.label: Aerial / satellite imagery + property hero photos
sources.notes: Read building massing for the acoustic-siting hypothesis. Cross-check venue inventory against property hero photos. Findings derived here are INFERENCE — label as such.

categories.name: entertainment_general
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Run on every review platform; this is the load-bearing category for the after-dinner-gap finding.

categories.name: activity
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Daytime/poolside coverage — distinguishes the engine-that-works from the after-dinner-gap.

categories.name: sentiment_negative
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Run lowest-score sort and pair with the sentiment-negative terms to surface harshest reviews fast.

categories.name: sentiment_positive
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Pair with most-helpful and 5-star reviews to identify named-talent and protect-this signals.

categories.name: segment
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Surface segment-mix signals (adults vs family vs teens) for the segment-opportunity section.

categories.name: time_of_day
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Use to triangulate the evening-cliff timing without committing to specific clock times pre-engagement.

categories.name: location
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Cross-reference with venue inventory recovered from YouTube walkthroughs.

categories.name: seasonal
categories.plannedCoverageNote: Use to spot holiday/peak-period programming gaps and renovation-window claims.

candidateEvidenceSlots.note: The money theme — aim for ≥6 records across multiple platforms and at least one 5-star fan asking for more.
Guests asking by name for an adult-only zone / live music / late hours. 2-3 is enough; quality > volume.
Protect-this signals — named talent and format-that-works reviews.
Standout-to-scale signals. Mayan / mariachi / regional content that over-performs.
Quality ceiling / venue-sightline / thermal-fail callouts. Often 1-2 records are enough.
The engine-that-works signal. Contrasts with the after-dinner-gap.
Family-strong evidence + teen-tier-absent evidence. The segment-opportunity flank.
External spill + internal bleed + thermal. Three distinct sub-problems; cover each.
Relaunch-window timing signal. 1 representative quote is enough.
